acceptanceCriteria: The peer range matches the tested host range, the README drops Python 3, and the coupled Pi version bump passes script/check-host-package-versions.sh.
body:
Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. integrations/pi/package.json:21 pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to exactly "0.85.1", so npm warns or refuses on any later Pi. integrations/pi/README.md still lists Python 3 as a prerequisite; nothing in the package uses it. Both edits change shipped files, so they need the coupled Pi adapter version bump (pi_adapter.go piAdapterVersion, package.json version and corvintIntegration.adapterVersion, compatibility.json, tests, matrix).

2026-09-29 Pi workflow closeout: confirmed package-version gate omitted the six new shipped process/core/operations/tasks/cockpit/workflow JavaScript modules. Reproduction: edits to those modules did not trigger the coupled-version assertion. Fixed in the isolated branch, with 11 package gate fixtures passing, and final adapter/native tuple 0.3.1 / Pi 0.99.1. Existing peer/README corrections also included. Installation and rollback receipts retained in /private/tmp/corvint-pi-wave/install/. Native completion remains OPEN.
title: Pi package pins its peer dependency to exactly 0.85.1 and its README still lists Python 3
